data.title: Nucleolar beacon for monitoring nucleolar morphology and proteomics in living cells
data.projectDescription: A novel approach combined nucleolar beacon with proximity labeling to obtain the nucleolar proteome. These techniques offer effective tools for investigating nucleolar functions in living cells and present a potential application method for drug delivery.
data.sampleProcessingProtocol: Preparation of proximity Labeling samples and streptavidin affinity pulldown Cells were cultured in 10 cm dishes. The following day, the pCDNA3.1-UltraID-NoB-EGFP plasmid was transfected. After 24 hours of protein expression, the medium was replaced and 50 μm of biotin was added. After an additional 18-hour incubation, the cells were washed three times with PBS, lysed using 1 mL RIPA lysate, and the supernatant was collected by centrifugation at 12000 rpm and 4 °C. The collected supernatant was added to Streptavidin Agarose beads (Beyotime, P2159), incubated at room temperature for 1 hour with rotation, and finally washed by centrifugation with PBST solution at 600×g for 5 minutes at 4ºC, and this process was repeated three times.  LC-MS/MS and data analysis Proteomic analysis was performed as previously described (61, 65). In brief, samples collected through streptavidin affinity pulldown (20 uL Streptavidin Agarose beads) were washed twice with 1 mL of NH4HCO3 (50 mM), and then resuspended by adding 100 uL of NH4HCO3, 10 uLof DTT (100 mM), and incubated at 56 ° C for 30 minutes. Additionally, 10 uL of iodoacetamide (300 mM) was added and incubated at room temperature in the dark for 15 minutes. Subsequently, trypsin (1:50, trypsin/ lysate ratio) was added and digestion was carried out overnight at 37 ° C. The next day, trypsin was added again and digestion was continued at 37 ° C for 5 hours. Digests were centrifuged through 3 kDa filter tubes so that only digested peptides can go through. The concentrations of peptides were ascertained by means of a modified Lowry Protein Assay Kit (Sangon Biotech, Co). Approximately 20 μg of peptides were subjected to desalting on Pierce C18 Spin Columns (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Co) in accordance with the manufacturer's directions. The peptides were analyzed using the Q Exactive HF-Orbitrap MS.
data.dataProcessingProtocol: Protein identification and label-free quantitation were carried out with Proteome Discoverer, version 2.2 software under default settings.
